nodes.description: Public owner address of the Owned contract, set once in the constructor from msg.sender and used by the onlyOwner modifier.
Token symbol string, set to HNL in the constructor.
Token name string, set in the constructor.
Token decimals, set to 10 in the constructor and used in the raw exponentiation of the total supply.
Total token supply stored in a private variable; returned by totalSupply and assigned in the constructor using unchecked arithmetic.
Mapping of holder address to token balance; written by the constructor, transfer, transferFrom and read by balanceOf.
Nested mapping of owner to spender to remaining allowance; written by approve and transferFrom and read by allowance.
Internal pure SafeMath addition that requires c >= a to guard against overflow.
Internal pure SafeMath subtraction that requires b <= a to guard against underflow.
Internal pure SafeMath multiplication that validates the product to guard against overflow.
Internal pure SafeMath division that requires a non-zero divisor.
Constructor of Owned: assigns owner = msg.sender, giving unrestricted ownership to the deployer.
Authorization modifier that requires msg.sender == owner before executing the modified function body.
Token constructor: sets metadata, mints the entire supply with raw multiplication and exponentiation, and credits owner.
Constant function returning the stored _totalSupply.
Constant function returning balances[tokenOwner]; no zero-address validation.
Transfers tokens from msg.sender to a recipient using SafeMath sub/add on the balances mapping and emits Transfer.
Sets allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens unconditionally, allowing the classic approval double-spend race.
Moves tokens from a holder to a recipient while debiting the caller allowance, using SafeMath but with no explicit allowance/zero-address checks.
Constant function returning allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
Payable fallback function that unconditionally reverts, rejecting all plain ether transfers.
Caller-controlled address used for ownership assignment, balance debits, allowances and authorization checks.
SafeMath.sub debit of balances[msg.sender] inside transfer; reverts on underflow.
SafeMath.add credit of balances[to] inside transfer; revert-guarded overflow.
SafeMath.sub debit of balances[from] inside transferFrom.
SafeMath.sub debit of allowed[from][msg.sender] inside transferFrom; this is the only implicit allowance check.
SafeMath.add credit of balances[to] inside transferFrom.
Raw, unchecked computation 500000000 * 10**uint256(decimals) for the initial supply in the constructor.
Recipient address parameter of transfer.
Token amount parameter of transfer.
Spender address parameter of approve.
Allowance amount parameter of approve.
Source holder address parameter of transferFrom.
Recipient address parameter of transferFrom.
Token amount parameter of transferFrom.
Account address parameter of balanceOf.
Token owner address parameter of allowance.
Spender address parameter of allowance.
First addend of SafeMath.add.
Second addend of SafeMath.add.
Minuend of SafeMath.sub.
Subtrahend of SafeMath.sub.
First factor of SafeMath.mul.
Second factor of SafeMath.mul.
Dividend of SafeMath.div.
Divisor of SafeMath.div.

edges.reason: The to recipient parameter flows into the body of transfer and is used as the balances mapping key.
The tokens parameter flows into transfer and drives the SafeMath sub/add balance mutations.
The spender parameter flows into approve and becomes the allowance mapping key.
The tokens parameter flows into approve and is written directly to the allowance mapping.
The from parameter flows into transferFrom and indexes balances and allowed.
The to parameter flows into transferFrom and indexes the credited balance.
The tokens parameter flows into transferFrom and drives two SafeMath subs and one add.
The tokenOwner parameter flows into balanceOf and indexes the balances mapping.
The tokenOwner parameter flows into allowance as the outer mapping key.
The spender parameter flows into allowance as the inner mapping key.
Addend a is summed in SafeMath.add whose overflow check guards the result.
Addend b is summed in SafeMath.add whose overflow check guards the result.
Minuend a is consumed by SafeMath.sub with its underflow require.
Subtrahend b is consumed by SafeMath.sub with its underflow require.
Factor a is multiplied in SafeMath.mul with product validation.
Factor b is multiplied in SafeMath.mul with product validation.
Dividend a is divided in SafeMath.div after the non-zero require.
Divisor b is checked for non-zero before division in SafeMath.div.
msg.sender is assigned directly to the owner state variable, granting unilateral privileged ownership to the deployer.
The onlyOwner modifier compares the untrusted msg.sender against the stored owner to gate privileged functions.
transfer debits balances indexed by msg.sender, so the caller controls the source account.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender], letting any caller set its own allowances.
transferFrom debits allowed[from][msg.sender], so the caller consumes its own allowance.
transfer performs the SafeMath.sub debit of balances[msg.sender].
transfer performs the SafeMath.add credit of balances[to].
transferFrom performs the SafeMath.sub debit of balances[from].
transferFrom performs the SafeMath.sub debit of allowed[from][msg.sender], the sole allowance constraint.
transferFrom performs the SafeMath.add credit of balances[to].
The constructor computes 500000000 * 10**uint256(decimals) with unchecked Solidity 0.4 arithmetic.
Constructor writes the symbol string to storage.
Constructor writes the name string to storage.
Constructor writes the decimals value used later for the supply scaling.
Constructor assigns the raw multiplication result to _totalSupply without overflow protection.
Constructor mints the entire supply into balances[owner].
The Owned constructor sets the owner state variable from msg.sender, establishing privileged access.
The onlyOwner modifier reads the stored owner for its authorization comparison.
require(msg.sender == owner) in onlyOwner is the access-control gate over the owner state variable.
transfer mutates the balances mapping for both sender and recipient.
transferFrom mutates the balances mapping for the from and to accounts.
transferFrom decreases the spender allowance stored in the allowed mapping.
approve overwrites allowed[msg.sender][spender] without zeroing it first, enabling the approval race condition.
balanceOf reads the balances mapping to return the requested account balance.
allowance reads the allowed mapping to return the remaining approved amount.
totalSupply returns the stored _totalSupply value.
transfer calls SafeMath.sub to perform the balance debit.
transfer calls SafeMath.add to perform the balance credit.
transferFrom calls SafeMath.sub twice, for the source balance and for the allowance.
transferFrom calls SafeMath.add to credit the recipient balance.

normalization_plan.reason: The recipient argument is only meaningful as the balances key written by transfer.
The amount argument is only meaningful through the SafeMath debits and credits executed by transfer.
The spender argument exists only to index the allowance mapping written by approve.
The allowance value parameter is stored verbatim by approve and has no independent behaviour.
The from argument is dissolved into the balances and allowed writes performed by transferFrom.
The to argument is dissolved into the recipient balance credit performed by transferFrom.
The amount argument is consumed entirely by the SafeMath operations inside transferFrom.
The lookup argument is only used to read the balances mapping in balanceOf.
The outer mapping key argument is only used to read the allowed mapping in allowance.
The inner mapping key argument is only used to read the allowed mapping in allowance.
Addend a is bound to the guarded addition inside SafeMath.add.
Addend b is bound to the guarded addition inside SafeMath.add.
Minuend a is bound to the underflow-checked subtraction inside SafeMath.sub.
Subtrahend b is bound to the underflow-checked subtraction inside SafeMath.sub.
Factor a is bound to the overflow-checked multiplication inside SafeMath.mul.
Factor b is bound to the overflow-checked multiplication inside SafeMath.mul.
Dividend a is bound to the guarded division inside SafeMath.div.
Divisor b is bound to the non-zero check performed inside SafeMath.div.
